title: Flow canvas
subtitle: Shape the scenario steps and expected outcomes first, then explore the website against the reviewed flow. Open script editing when you are ready to generate automation.
subtitlePlan: Adjust the action order and expected outcomes. After saving, run the flow step by step; evidence is stored under each execution node.
emptyHint: Run the QA agent analysis first, then come back to inspect the flow.
readOnlyHint: This view shows the analyzed scenario. The editor lets you refine steps, add locators, compile, and save an automation script without changing the analysis.
subtitleEdit: Start an automation draft from this scenario. Adjust steps, add locators, preview the compiled result, and save it as a test script; the requirement analysis remains unchanged.
planDescription: Each action becomes its own execution node. The saved plan drives this exploration while the original requirement analysis stays unchanged.
planCanvasHint: The canvas below previews the current plan. Save it before starting guided exploration.
planSaved: Flow saved. Runtime will create one execution node for each action.
planNeedsSave: The current flow has unsaved changes. Save it before exploration so the task uses the reviewed version.
planOutcomeLimit: Keep no more than 20 expected outcomes.
missingSutUrl: Configure the target website URL in project settings first.
